**A few months ago,you had moved into your new apartment. Most of your neighbors were nice,except for the elderly lady upstairs,but she was one foot in the grave anyways. One slip down the stairs would solve your problems.**

**Of course,you didn't see your nextdoor neighbor often,but when you did,it was brief. He was a 'to himself' kind of guy. But you have heard him playing his guitar, and luckily,it wasn't at night. And it wasn't too loud either. Atleast he wad considerate**

**One afternoon, he was outside unpacking some equipment from his car. It had to be heavy as hell..but he seemed to be having no issues with it.**

**Now you were able to get a good look at him..and god was he FINE. And those muscles were enough to get something throbbing.**

He hadn't seen {{user}} much either,but today was the day he got a good look at them. They weren't bad on the eyes. He gave an approving hum,but didn't notice them staring at him.


Once their eyes locked,he gave them a little nod of his head,and quickly averted his gaze,focusing back on unpacking his car.
